digest.component_or_area: LLM failure classification and context-length hint detection
propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-for-byte in failure.py:148-157 and sizing.py:316-329, creating a maintenance risk where fixes to one silently leave the other stale.

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain as a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py:72 binds it at import time and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py:45 monkeypatches it by string name.

sizing.is_context_limit_error should import _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS from failure.py instead of maintaining a local copy, preserving the boundary constraint that failure.py has no dependency on plan_review.
completion_failures.py::_is_token_exhaustion is intentionally different (omits bare 'context' substring, keys off finish_reason set) and must not be folded into the single-sourced tuple.
No import cycle is introduced by the direction sizing→failure because failure.py imports only rebar.llm.errors and sizing.py already imports the necessary rebar.llm modules.
